svg.text: Paired cost ratio, full list (A) vs retrieval (B)
One dot per query × order (40 per N); bar = median. Undiscounted list prices, so prompt caching cannot flatter either method
A cost ÷ B cost, same query and order
Observed per-judgement cost at a sampled pool state — not the cumulative cost of a discussion, and not the full Freedi pipeline.
